visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium: Live-action video. A young Asian woman with long dark hair, wearing a pale pink hoodie, is captured in a close-up shot. She looks directly into the camera lens with a neutral expression that softens into a subtle smile. The setting is a dimly lit indoor space with a dark, textured wall in the background. (2) The scene shifts to extreme close-ups of the woman's face. White curved lines and text graphics appear over her eyes and nose to highlight specific facial features. She turns her head slightly, looking upwards and to the side, showcasing her makeup under bright, flattering indoor lighting. (3) The woman is now seen with a shorter, chin-length dark bob haircut. She wears a grey wool coat and is shown in a bright indoor setting, possibly a cafe, holding a spoon near a cup. Her expression is cheerful and satisfied as she looks towards something off-camera. (4) The woman appears in a professional studio setting with a clean, light-colored background. She wears a white crew-neck t-shirt and several beaded necklaces. She smiles widely, revealing her teeth, and looks around the room. The lighting is high-key and professional, typical of a studio. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, labeled "after" on the top and "before" on the bottom. The "after" shot shows the woman with polished makeup and short hair, while the "before" shot shows her in the pink hoodie with long hair and a more tired appearance. (6) In a makeup studio, a second woman with long dark hair (the makeup artist), wearing a light blue shirt, is seen applying makeup to the first woman's eye area using a small tool. The first woman wears a peach-colored ribbed top. The background features studio mirrors and soft pink decor. (7) Screens of an Instagram profile and various promotional graphics are shown. These feature photographs of K-pop idols, list course modules in Traditional Chinese text, and display the makeup artist's professional portrait. (8) The final scene shows both women standing together in the studio. They smile warmly at the camera and use their fingers to point downwards toward a yellow text overlay at the bottom of the frame. The lighting remains bright and professional.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a driving percussive beat and bright synthesizer pads. A female narrator speaks with a high-arousal, friendly, and enthusiastic tone. She uses a rapid speech rate with clear articulation. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the first visual scene cut. (2) As the narrator describes her facial features, a soft 'ding' SFX sounds, synchronized with the appearance of graphical highlights on screen. The music maintains a constant tempo around 124 BPM, providing a rhythmic backdrop to the continuous speech. The vocal pitch shows high variability, conveying excitement. (3) A digital 'blip' SFX signals a transition to the narrator's experience in a makeup studio. The BGM remains present at a moderate volume, balanced below the vocals. The ambient environment is studio-clean with no significant background noise. The narrator's tone remains animated and persuasive. (4) The audio phase shifts as the narrator lists celebrity clients. A subtle 'pop' SFX is used during the rapid sequence of images. The music continues its major-mode melodic loop. There are no vocal pauses longer than half a second, maintaining a dense information flow. (5) In the final phase, the narrator provides a call to action. Her voice remains high-valence and positive. A final melodic 'ding' SFX emphasizes the mention of the discount code. The BGM fades out quickly after the final spoken sentence, ending the track cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Personal Solution -> Expert Credentials -> Course Overview -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote an online Korean-style makeup course. The video uses the creator's personal transformation ('before vs after') to demonstrate the course's effectiveness, highlights the instructor's high-profile work with famous K-pop idols to build authority, and provides a limited-time discount code to drive immediate sales.
